description: vacation.rs handle_vacation_set uses Ok(_) arm in both the direct-update path (lines 148-153) and the upsert post-create update path (lines 175-186). This discards the update_object Some(obj) return, so server-modified fields are silently omitted from the updated map — always inserts Value::Null instead. Same class as JMAP-4ii.1/45/50 but vacation.rs was missed in all fix rounds. Acceptance: updated map must echo obj when update_object returns Ok(Some(obj)), matching the pattern fixed in identity.rs and email.rs.
title: VacationResponse/set update discards Ok(Some(obj)) echo
